description: Portrait of Lucille Webb sitting in profile on the ledge of the picture window in O'Keeffe's Ghost Ranch studio; most of the room and Lucille's body is in shadow with illumination from the window. Lucille wears a a head scarf, pearl necklace and pearl earnings, a white short sleeved polo shirt with an upturned collar, visible through the window the desert landscape with alluvial fan bluffs and mesas.
title: Lucille in Window
